_notes: deploy-worker-assets does NOT create routes; run deploy/create-routes.py (needs the custom.cloudflare credential) or create the three _routes_for_parent patterns in the Cloudflare dashboard pointing at the 'cert-bootcamps' worker.
site/worker.js strips the /bootcamps prefix and delegates to the static-asset manifest, so the worker can serve all three domains' /bootcamps/* paths from one asset tree.
